mapper.select: SELECT , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.ingest_task_id ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR ',') FROM campus_monitor_ingest_task_relation r WHERE r.monitor_task_id = campus_monitor_task.monitor_task_id AND r.deleted = 0) AS ingest_task_ids, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.task_name ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR '、') FROM campus_monitor_ingest_task_relation r JOIN campus_ingest_task t ON t.task_id = r.ingest_task_id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE r.monitor_task_id = campus_monitor_task.monitor_task_id AND r.deleted = 0) AS ingest_task_names, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_monitor_result mr WHERE mr.monitor_task_id = campus_monitor_task.monitor_task_id AND mr.deleted = 0) AS display_result_count FROM campus_monitor_task WHERE monitor_task_id = #{monitorTaskId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
